title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes
tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

judge.summary: Three polished coffee ads deliver the requested copy, cohesive campaign styling and well-adapted layouts in all three formats.

must_haves.item: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
must_haves.why: Separate square, portrait and landscape images are shown in the requested proportions.

must_haves.item: All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
must_haves.why: Each image features a cream coffee cup with visible rising steam, cream surroundings and dark-green text and CTA.

must_haves.item: Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
must_haves.why: All three contain the exact required wording, with the brand naturally wrapped across two lines in the landscape version.

must_haves.item: The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
must_haves.why: Matching cream ceramic cups, serif branding, sans-serif supporting copy, green buttons and warm directional lighting establish a cohesive campaign.

must_haves.item: Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.
must_haves.why: The square and portrait use balanced stacked compositions, while the landscape rearranges text and cup side by side; no copy is clipped or imagery visibly stretched.
